title: euphorbia pinea var. azorica
intro: Euphorbia pinea var. azorica, commonly known as the Azores spurge, is a rare and endangered succulent plant species native to the Azores Islands. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly for its potential health benefits in treating inflammation, wounds, and skin issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are said to promote healing, reduce pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Euphorbia pinea var. azorica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
